notablePrerequisites: Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Devoted Druid by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Gauntlets of Chaos by paying {5} and sacrificing it, exchanging control of Vorinclex and any valid target.
Activate Devoted Druid by putting zero -1/-1 counters on it due to Vorinclex's effect, untapping Devoted Druid.
Activate Devoted Druid by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat from step 3.
